title: Sandra P NDE 2493
content: I remember walking and everything went black and next time I was being revived via CPR. It's funny, I remember it as if it happened yesterday. I was floating on my back and I was going feet first to this light at the end of this - not like a tunnel - more like clouds. And I had this sense that there were people/bodies there watching me go and I heard this incredible music being performed without instruments - it was vocal. And no words - just music done vocally. I didn't want to come back but I could hear my name being called. I had no sense of time, pain, anything. I felt wonderful and yet confused. But I knew I was going to a good place. This is all I care to say at this time about it. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: sometime in the late 1980's NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. I don't know for sure. I remember walking and everything went black and next time I was being revived via CPR. Other people said I wasn't breathing and when I woke up CPR was being performed. How do you consider the content of your experience? Mixed Did you feel separated from your body? No No How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Not sure what you are asking me. Were your thoughts speeded up? Neither Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Neither Were your senses more vivid than usual? More so than usual Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Well, I heard this music. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Uncertain It was more like clouds. Did you see any beings in your experience? Sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Uncertain I could sense bodies/people by me. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? Neither Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Bright white light at the end. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Neither What emotions did you feel during the experience? I am not sure. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Neither Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? Neither Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? A barrier I was not permitted to cross; or 'sent back' to life involuntarily God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate Catholic Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Moderate Catholic Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Neither Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Sensed their presence Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I treasure every encounter. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes Hard to explain and not sure if anyone will believe me. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Uncertain I am not sure at this point. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? I am more sure about life after death now. I feel it may have been a gift from God to experience this but I am not sure how to use this gift as of yet. Have you ever shared this experience with others? No Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real I didn't know what to do or if I should tell anyone, and then decided to keep it to myself. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real I remember it in detail as if it happened yesterday. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? I am a bit afraid to divulge this information. I've kept this a secret for the longest time. I hope you don't think I am crazy.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Not like a tunnel; more like clouds.

arrival.other_being_detail: Sensed there were people/bodies watching as she went toward the light.

environment.environment_other_detail: Bright white light at the end; transitional area described as 'clouds.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Walking, then everything went black; later revived via CPR (others said she wasn't breathing).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Heard incredible wordless vocal music; sensed people/bodies watching; heard her name being called.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Went black, then experienced floating feet-first toward bright white light through 'clouds,' sensed others present, heard music, encountered a barrier, then returned while hearing her name called.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Incredible wordless vocal music performed without instruments; heard her name being called back.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was floating on my back and I was going feet first to this light at the end of this - not like a tunnel - more like clouds.”
